_comment: 013: signals -- the map's events. A signal site shows one (seeded, never twice in a run) and the player picks an option. Every option states its whole cost and gain up front: no hidden dice. Effects, applied in this order: scrap (+/-; a cost needs that much scrap or the option is refused), hp (every living machine, never below 1 or above full), hp_one (the first living machine), part (a part of at least that rarity into the hold), tuned_part (the same, already tuned), reveal (scout every site within that many columns), front (the Reclaimer takes that many columns now), fight (skirmish|elite: a fight here, rewarded as that kind). In the content hash: effects are rules.

hauler_wreck.title: A CRASHED HAULER
hauler_wreck.text: A Combine hauler lies on its side, cargo doors sprung. Something inside still hums, and the wreck is not as settled as it looks.

options.label: STRIP IT
options.text: An uncommon part or better. The wreck shifts while you work: every machine takes 2.

lone_rig.title: A SPIKED RIG, ALONE
lone_rig.text: One of the Reclaimer's heavy rigs has thrown a track and its escort is circling back for it. It has not seen you yet.

options.label: BREAK IT
options.text: A fight here against an elite and its escort, for an elite's salvage.

scavengers.title: SCAVENGERS AT A FIRE
scavengers.text: Free machines from another yard, sharing a fire. They have parts to trade, and time to look at yours.

options.label: TRADE
options.text: Pay 12 scrap for a tuned part.

relay_mast.title: A RELAY MAST
relay_mast.text: A Combine relay mast, still standing. From the top you would see half the yard. Its copper would buy a lot.

options.label: CLIMB IT
options.text: Scout every site within two columns.

tool_locker.title: A SEALED TOOL LOCKER
tool_locker.text: A foreman's locker, welded shut and wired. Whatever is in there, someone wanted it kept.

options.label: FORCE IT
options.text: A rare part. The locker's charge goes off in the first machine's face: it takes 4.

downed_drone.title: A DOWNED DRONE
downed_drone.text: One of the Reclaimer's scouts, down in the dirt, its core still warm. Taking it will not go unnoticed.

options.label: TAKE ITS CORE
options.text: A tuned uncommon part. The Reclaimer takes a column now.

fuel_cache.title: A FUEL CACHE
fuel_cache.text: Drums of clean fuel, sealed before the Combine left. The machines run better on it, and the drums are worth something empty.

options.label: REFUEL
options.text: Every machine is patched for 2, and +6 scrap.

crane_cab.title: A SWINGING CRANE CAB
crane_cab.text: A crane cab hangs by one cable over the road, creaking. Its controls are still lit.

options.label: CUT IT DOWN
options.text: +16 scrap. It lands hard: one machine takes 3.

options.label: CLIMB UP
options.text: See every site within two zones.

oil_spring.title: AN OIL SPRING
oil_spring.text: Black oil wells up out of a cracked tank, warm and clean enough to use.

dead_mechanic.title: A MECHANIC'S LAST JOB
dead_mechanic.text: A free machine lies where its mechanic left it, half rebuilt, a part still in the vice.

options.label: TAKE THE PART
options.text: An uncommon part or better, already tuned.

options.label: BURY IT PROPERLY
options.text: Every machine patches 2. It feels right.

spiked_patrol.title: A SPIKED PATROL
spiked_patrol.text: Three spiked rigs on a slow patrol, not looking your way. Yet.

options.label: AMBUSH THEM
options.text: A fight here, paid as an ordinary one.

options.label: WAIT THEM OUT
options.text: The Reclaimer gains a zone while you wait.

scrap_bridge.title: A SCRAP BRIDGE
scrap_bridge.text: A bridge of welded car bodies over a slag channel. It groans under the first machine.

options.label: CROSS FAST
options.text: Every machine takes 2; +8 scrap from what falls off.

signal_flare.title: A SIGNAL FLARE
signal_flare.text: Someone fired a flare from the next yard over. It is still burning.

options.label: FOLLOW IT
options.text: See every site within three zones.

vending_cage.title: A TRADER'S DROP CAGE
vending_cage.text: A locked cage with a coin slot and a part inside. The price is stencilled on the bars.

reclaimer_scout.title: A RECLAIMER SCOUT
reclaimer_scout.text: A lone Reclaimer drone, nose in a heap. It has not seen you.

options.label: SNEAK PAST
options.text: Nothing -- and it does not see you.

coolant_leak.title: A COOLANT LEAK
coolant_leak.text: Blue coolant sprays from a burst main. It would soak into a hot machine.

options.label: SOAK THE CREW
options.text: Every machine patches 2; one takes the cold badly and loses 2.

old_billboard.title: AN OLD COMBINE BILLBOARD
old_billboard.text: "THE MERIDIAN COMBINE: WE BUILD WHAT LASTS." The frame holding it up does.

sinkhole.title: A SINKHOLE
sinkhole.text: The road gives way. Something shiny glints at the bottom.

options.label: CLIMB DOWN
options.text: A rare part. The climb costs every machine 3.

free_machines.title: FREE MACHINES
free_machines.text: Two free machines, battered, heading the other way. They have spares, and they have heard of you.

options.label: TRADE
options.text: Pay 10 scrap: a tuned part, common or better.

options.label: SHARE NEWS
options.text: See every site within two zones.

magnet_crane.title: A LIVE MAGNET CRANE
magnet_crane.text: A magnet crane still running, dropping scrap in a heap every few minutes.

options.label: WAIT FOR A DROP
options.text: +18 scrap. The Reclaimer gains a zone.

burned_garage.title: A BURNED-OUT GARAGE
burned_garage.text: The roof is gone; the hoists are not.

sentry_gun.title: A SENTRY GUN
sentry_gun.text: A Combine sentry, still tracking anything that moves, guarding a parts locker.

options.label: RUSH IT
options.text: A rare part; one machine takes 5 getting there.

prayer_wall.title: A WALL OF NAMES
prayer_wall.text: Machine names scratched into a container wall, hundreds of them. Someone left a toolbox at the foot of it.

slag_geyser.title: A SLAG GEYSER
slag_geyser.text: A crust over molten slag. It cracks on a rhythm you could almost time.

options.label: TIME IT
options.text: +20 scrap of cooled ingots; every machine takes 3.

abandoned_bay.title: AN ABANDONED BAY
abandoned_bay.text: An assembly bay like yours, lights on, nobody home. A part sits ready on the lift.

rumour.title: A RUMOUR ON THE WIRE
rumour.text: A free machine's broadcast, looping: the warlord here keeps its hoard close.

options.label: LISTEN
options.text: See every site within two zones.

wreck_field.title: A FIELD OF WRECKS
wreck_field.text: A whole convoy, dead in a row. Picked over, mostly.

options.label: PICK IT OVER AGAIN
options.text: +15 scrap; the Reclaimer gains a zone.
